title.narrative: To prevent 70,000 to 80,000 new HIV infections by 2017 through high impact and targeted prevention programs, intensified HIV testing and counselling, elimination of MTCT and quality care and treatment - Ethiopia (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Ethiopia, HIV, HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control Office (HAPCO)This program has the following goals: Ending TB epidemic in Ethiopia. To prevent 70,000 - 80,000 new HIV infections by 2020. To save 500,000 - 550,000 lives due to HIV/AIDS by 2020. The objectives of this program are: Attain Virtual elimination of MTCT of HIV. Implement high impact and targeted prevention programs. Improve access to TB,TB/HIV and MDR-TB services. Improve community ownership on TB prevention and control. Improve quality of TB, TB/HIV and MDR-TB service delivery. Intensify targeted HIV testing and counseling. Optimize and sustain high quality care and treatment
